name: Banking & KYC Scams
description: Fraudulent messages and calls impersonating banks claiming account suspension, PAN card expiry, or incomplete KYC to harvest NetBanking credentials.
common_indicators: Urgent threats that account or debit card will be blocked within 24 hours
Unsolicited SMS containing links to .xyz, .top, or typo-domains
Requests for OTP, NetBanking password, or debit card CVV
Sender ID that doesn't match official bank shortcode

typical_attack_flow.title: Urgent Bait SMS
typical_attack_flow.description: Victim receives text claiming account will be deactivated due to pending KYC.

typical_attack_flow.title: Cloned Phishing Portal
typical_attack_flow.description: Link leads to exact replica of bank login screen.

typical_attack_flow.title: Credential & OTP Interception
typical_attack_flow.description: Scammers capture login details and trigger live OTP prompt to drain funds.

recommended_safety_measures: Never click on SMS or WhatsApp links to update KYC
Banks only update KYC via official branches or verified in-app video KYC
Never disclose OTP to anyone, including bank representatives

name: UPI & Payment App Scams
description: Reverse-charge fraud, fake refund requests, and QR code manipulation where victims are tricked into sending money instead of receiving it.
common_indicators: Claiming that entering your UPI PIN is required to 'receive' money
Fake screenshot of money transfer shared by buyer on OLX/Marketplace
Collect requests sent with memos like 'Refund Approved' or 'Cashback'

typical_attack_flow.title: False Buyer / Refund Contact
typical_attack_flow.description: Scammer poses as eager buyer or support agent offering refund.

typical_attack_flow.title: Send Deceptive Collect Request
typical_attack_flow.description: Sends a UPI collect request or QR code labeled 'Receive Amount'.

typical_attack_flow.title: PIN Entry Deduction
typical_attack_flow.description: Victim enters PIN thinking it accepts payment; funds are instantly deducted.

recommended_safety_measures: Remember: UPI PIN is ONLY entered to SEND money, NEVER to receive money
Do not scan QR codes sent by strangers on classifieds or social media
Check the payee name and VPA before confirming any transaction

name: Fake Customer Support
description: Search engine SEO poisoned phone numbers where victims searching for airline, bank, or courier support call scammers directly.
common_indicators: Customer care number found on unofficial Google search results or social media
Agent asks you to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or RustDesk on your phone
Agent asks for a small nominal fee (₹10 or $1) to register your complaint

typical_attack_flow.title: SEO Poisoning
typical_attack_flow.description: Scammers place fake customer helpline numbers on Google Maps or forums.

typical_attack_flow.title: Remote Access Request
typical_attack_flow.description: Fake executive asks user to install remote desktop app to 'fix the glitch'.

typical_attack_flow.title: Device Takeover
typical_attack_flow.description: Scammer views screen during OTP generation and takes over banking apps.

recommended_safety_measures: Only retrieve contact numbers directly inside official verified apps
Never install remote desktop software (AnyDesk, TeamViewer) at caller's request
Disconnect immediately if caller asks for PIN or screen sharing

name: Part-Time Job & Task Scams
description: Telegram/WhatsApp offers for simple tasks like liking YouTube videos or rating hotels, ending in crypto deposit traps.
common_indicators: Promises of ₹3,000 to ₹10,000 per day for simple 10-minute tasks
Recruiter contacts via unsolicited WhatsApp or Telegram message
Demands a 'security deposit' or 'VIP task investment' to withdraw earned balance

typical_attack_flow.title: Small Initial Payout
typical_attack_flow.description: Victim earns ₹200-500 for liking 3 videos to establish artificial trust.

typical_attack_flow.title: Prepaid Task Upsell
typical_attack_flow.description: Added to Telegram group; instructed to invest ₹5,000 for ₹8,000 return.

typical_attack_flow.title: Withdrawal Freeze
typical_attack_flow.description: Platform freezes funds; demands larger deposits until victim exhausts savings.

recommended_safety_measures: No legitimate company pays huge sums for liking YouTube videos
Never pay money upfront to get a job or unlock task earnings
Block unknown recruiters messaging from international numbers

name: Investment & Crypto Doubling Scams
description: Bogus trading platforms, WhatsApp investment advisory groups, and artificial AI trading bots guaranteeing risk-free returns.
common_indicators: Guaranteed 200% to 500% returns with 'zero risk'
Added to WhatsApp/Telegram groups showing screenshots of massive profits
Fake trading dashboard showing inflated profits that cannot be withdrawn

typical_attack_flow.title: Social Engineering Group
typical_attack_flow.description: Victim added to group of 50+ accounts (all scammers) celebrating huge gains.

typical_attack_flow.title: Fake Trading Portal
typical_attack_flow.description: User deposits funds; dashboard shows balance multiplying rapidly.

typical_attack_flow.title: Tax/Release Fee Extortion
typical_attack_flow.description: Scammers demand 30% advance tax before allowing any withdrawal.

recommended_safety_measures: Only trade through SEBI/SEC registered brokers
Guaranteed high returns do not exist in genuine financial markets
Never wire money to individual bank accounts for corporate investments

name: Brand & Email Phishing
description: Cloned emails from Apple, Microsoft, Netflix, or PayPal claiming billing failure or unusual sign-in activity.
common_indicators: Sender email address has a weird domain (e.g. support@netflix-billing-sec.com)
Generic greeting ('Dear Customer') instead of your actual name
Urgent threat that subscription or account will be permanently canceled

typical_attack_flow.title: Deceptive Email
typical_attack_flow.description: Victim receives billing failure notification for popular streaming/cloud service.

typical_attack_flow.title: Fake Login & Payment
typical_attack_flow.description: User enters login password and credit card details to 'update billing'.

typical_attack_flow.title: Account Hijack
typical_attack_flow.description: Card details harvested; account password changed immediately.

recommended_safety_measures: Check sender address closely, not just display name
Log in directly by typing the official website in browser address bar
Enable multi-factor hardware or app-based 2FA

name: Delivery & Parcel Rescheduling
description: Smishing texts impersonating FedEx, DHL, USPS, or India Post claiming a parcel could not be delivered due to wrong address.
common_indicators: SMS with tracking number claiming delivery failed today
Link has typosquatting domain (.top, .xyz, -parcel-redelivery)
Demands $1.50 or ₹50 redelivery fee by debit/credit card

typical_attack_flow.title: Failed Delivery Notice
typical_attack_flow.description: SMS alerts user that package is held at depot.

typical_attack_flow.title: Address & Card Skimmer
typical_attack_flow.description: Landing page asks for updated address and payment for redelivery.

typical_attack_flow.title: Unauthorized Card Siphon
typical_attack_flow.description: Credit card data stolen; multiple unauthorized transactions initiated.

recommended_safety_measures: Official couriers leave physical slips or notify through their official registered app
Never pay nominal redelivery fees through links received via SMS
Check tracking numbers only on official carrier websites

name: Digital Arrest & Govt Impersonation
description: Criminals posing as Police, CBI, Customs, or Telecom Department holding victims on coercive Skype video calls under 'Digital Arrest'.
common_indicators: Call claiming your Aadhaar or passport was found in narcotics parcel or illegal SIM cards
Caller demands Skype/WhatsApp video call with fake police station background
Strict instruction not to disconnect call or tell family ('State Secrecy')

typical_attack_flow.title: Interactive IVR Call
typical_attack_flow.description: Automated call claims mobile connection will be disconnected in 2 hours.

typical_attack_flow.title: Fake Police Video Call
typical_attack_flow.description: Transferred to actor in uniform with forged police seal and fake FIR.

typical_attack_flow.title: Fund Verification Transfer
typical_attack_flow.description: Coerced to transfer entire savings to 'RBI Escrow Account' for verification.

recommended_safety_measures: There is NO legal provision for 'Digital Arrest' under Indian law or any international jurisdiction
Police and enforcement agencies NEVER investigate citizens over Skype or WhatsApp
Immediately disconnect and dial 1930 or visit local police station

name: Social Media & Impersonation Scams
description: Cloned Instagram/Facebook profiles messaging friends for emergency medical funds, or fake giveaways.
common_indicators: Close friend or relative messages asking for urgent loan via UPI
Account has slight typo in username or was recently created
Excuses why they cannot speak over phone voice call

typical_attack_flow.title: Profile Cloning
typical_attack_flow.description: Scammers clone photos and name of target's real friend.

typical_attack_flow.title: Urgent Medical Crisis
typical_attack_flow.description: Messages target: 'My sister is in hospital, UPI limit reached, please send ₹15,000'.

typical_attack_flow.title: Disappearance
typical_attack_flow.description: Once transferred, scammer blocks victim and targets next friend on contact list.

recommended_safety_measures: Always call the person directly on phone before sending any emergency money
Verify profile creation date and mutual follower connections
Report and block cloned accounts immediately

name: QR Phishing (Quishing)
description: Malicious QR stickers pasted over legitimate parking meters, restaurant menus, or shared via email to evade text spam filters.
common_indicators: Physical QR sticker pasted on top of another existing sign or meter
Email with no text but an embedded QR code asking you to verify MFA
QR code opens browser directly without displaying the URL destination first

typical_attack_flow.title: QR Baiting
typical_attack_flow.description: Victim scans QR code to pay for parking or authenticate enterprise login.

typical_attack_flow.title: Mobile Landing Page
typical_attack_flow.description: Directed to phishing clone designed specifically for mobile screens.

typical_attack_flow.title: Session / Token Theft
typical_attack_flow.description: Victim enters credentials or approves push notification, granting account access.

recommended_safety_measures: Use QR scanner apps that preview the full URL before opening
Feel for raised physical stickers pasted over legitimate merchant signs
Never scan QR codes sent in security alert emails
